Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Nafeesh Quraishi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.

Vakalatnama filed by Shri Satyendra Yadav, Advocate on behalf of respondent no. 2 is taken on
record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and learned counsel appearing for respondent no. 2.
3.

The present application has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 20.02.2023 as well as summoning order dated 17.04.2023 passed in Criminal Case No. 7006 of 2023 arising out of F.I.R. No. 99 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Mohd. Juned And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. U.P. ...

4. Learned counsel for the applicants and learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 jointly submit that in pursuance of the earlier order dated 09.10.2023 passed in Application u/s 482 No. 9745 of 2023, the matter was sent before the court below for verification of the compromise deed.
5. It is evident from the record that the factum of the compromise has been verified by the court below vide his report dated 21.10.2023.
The compromise deed is appended as Annexure 5 to the application, which goes to show that respondent no. 2 does not want to prosecute the applicants.
6. Learned A.G.A. fairly concedes that compromise has been effected between the parties and the same has duly been verified by the court below.

7. Hon'ble Apex Court, in catena of decisions, viz., Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab, 2012 AIR SCW 5333, B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana, (2003) 3 SCC 675 and Narinder Singh Vs. State of Punjab, (2014) 6 SCC 466, has held that inherent power can be used to do real and substantial justice.

sentences.text: Hence, inherent power can be exercised to speed up the process of ending the criminal proceedings where the settlement is arrived at between the parties.

8. In view of the aforesaid fact that parties do not want to pursue the case any further and the matter has been mutually settled between the parties by way of the compromise, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter any further.
9. For the discussions made above, the present application is allowed.

10. Charge sheet dated 20.02.2023 as well as summoning order dated 17.04.2023 passed in Criminal Case No. 7006 of 2023 arising out of F.I.R. No. 99 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Gonda are hereby quashed.
11. Office is directed to send a copy of this order to the court concerned, forthwith.
